newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks drift lower, watch bond yield.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks drift lower, watch bond yield.

text.p: U.S. stocks declined in late monring trading on Thursday, watchful as bond prices remained soft and the benchmark 30-year U.S. Treasury bond flirted with a key seven percent yield.

The Dow industrials were trading off around 32 points or 0.44 percent at 7259, after trading up to 7310. The long bond, which hit a seven percent yield earlier, was trading off 11/32 at a yield of 6.99 percent.
Nasdaq, which had been firm yesterday even as the Dow slumped on weaker bonds and profit taking, was trading off about five points at 1370.
